;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[International military intervention against ISIL]], [[Battle of Baghuz Fawqani]]
**[[Syrian Democratic Forces]] declares progress in [[Syria]] after an [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] camp on the outskirts of [[Al-Baghuz Fawqani|Baghuz]] is captured. [https://www.npr.org/2019/03/19/704730563/isis-camp-in-baghouz-is-captured-as-u-s-allies-celebrate-progress-in-syria (NPR)] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/isis-fighters-tied-to-killing-4-americans-in-syria-captured-by-us-backed-fighters-us-official-says (Fox News)]

;Health and environment
*The U.S. [[Food and Drug Administration]] approves Sage Therapeutics' Zulresso, also known as [[allopregnanolone]] or brexanolone, for treatment of [[postpartum depression]]. It is the first drug approved to specifically target the disease, which is the most common complication of [[childbirth]]. [https://www.statnews.com/2019/03/19/fda-sage-postpartum-depression-drug/ (STAT News)] [https://www.fda.gov/NewsEvents/Newsroom/PressAnnouncements/ucm633919.htm (US FDA)]

**[[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] express interest in jointly hosting the [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup]]. ;Politics and elections
*The [[President of Kazakhstan]], [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]], announces his resignation after 29 years in office. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kazakhstan-president/president-of-kazakhstan-nursultan-nazarbayev-resigns-idUSKCN1R01N1 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**A judge issues an arrest warrant against presidential candidate [[Thelma Aldana]]; however, as the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] registered Aldana as a presidential candidate, she enjoys immunity and can not be arrested. [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1469446/world (''Arab News'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] awards this year's [[Abel Prize]] to [[Karen Uhlenbeck]]  for "her pioneering achievements in geometric partial differential equations, gauge theory and integrable systems."  Uhlenbeck is the first woman to win this prize. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/karen-uhlenbeck-is-first-woman-to-receive-abel-prize-in-mathematics/ar-BBUXk35 (''The New York Times'' via MSN.com)]
